categories.evidence: Touches src/httpserver.cpp and carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label.
categories.rationale: Adds unit test coverage and cleans up control flow in HTTPRemoteClient disconnection handling following the removal of libevent. It resolves misleading idle timeout logging and enables follow-up work in #36204, but is an internal refinement deferrable without immediate harm to callers.
